messages:
Renee: Hi all  I'm Renee (data infra) starting today. Quick onboarding ask: need read access to GCP project `analytics-staging-5` and billing viewer on billing account `redwood-apac-bill-09` so I can check cost reports for APAC tests. Also need to confirm APAC quotas are available (asia-southeast1). I tried opening the project and got a 403 on the Billing page. Who should I loop in?

Ibrahim: Welcome Renee! For GCP please share the project ID (looks like you did) and your email. Billing viewer is handled by finance, but platform-ops can do a quick check on org-level constraints. What's your email?

Renee: renee@redwood.com. The 403 shows on console path: Billing > Overview. I can view other consoles though.

platform-ops: Hey @Renee, project `analytics-staging-5` is under folder `apac-team` which currently has an org policy limiting resourceLocations to `asia-southeast1` only. That shouldn't block billing view, so the 403 is likely IAM. Do you see `You do not have permission to view billing` or a different message?

Renee: Exact error: "You do not have permission to view this project's billing account (403)". I think the billing account is `redwood-apac-bill-09` (I was told).

Ibrahim: Ok, finance needs the billing account ID and the user email to grant `roles/billing.viewer`. @cloud-finance-bot can you open a ticket? Include project and reason (onboarding cost analysis).

cloud-finance-bot: Ticket FIN-9003 created: "Grant billing.viewer to renee@redwood.com on redwood-apac-bill-09". Assigned to finance-team. ETA: 1 business day. :money_with_wings:

platform-ops: In parallel, please run and paste these (redact tokens):
```
gcloud alpha billing accounts list --format=json

gcloud projects get-iam-policy analytics-staging-5 --format=json
```

Renee: Pasted outputs (redacted): billing accounts list shows `redwood-apac-bill-09` id `03Z-AAA-BBB`. Project IAM bindings only show `group:apac-admins@redwood.com` and `serviceAccount:analytics-sa@analytics-staging-5.iam.gserviceaccount.com` with no user bindings.

Ibrahim: That explains it  billing.viewer must be granted on the billing account explicitly. Finance will handle that. For quotas: platform-ops can check project quotas in asia-southeast1 once you have billing access. If you need quick ephemeral compute, I can temporarily add you to `apac-onboard` group with compute.viewer for 24h to run the tests while finance grants billing.viewer. Do you need to create resources or just run read-only checks?

Renee: I need to spin up one ephemeral VM (small) to run a latency test and a sample job. So I need compute.instanceAdmin.v1 for the VM or a role that allows creating a small instance. Temporary is fine.

platform-ops: Ok I'll add you to `apac-onboard` with an IAM binding that allows `roles/compute.instanceAdmin.v1` on the project for 24 hours. Note: we will set an automated revoke. Also confirm region: `asia-southeast1`?

Renee: Yes asia-southeast1. Thanks. Also for bookkeeping, what's the expected charge policy for onboarding ephemeral VMs? I don't want to accidentally spin up something expensive.

cloud-finance-bot: For ephemeral onboarding VMs under `apac-onboard` we cap cost at $20 per session by policy. Any exceedance requires finance sign-off. Ticket FIN-9003 will document this.

platform-ops: Done  added `renee@redwood.com` to group `apac-onboard` with `roles/compute.instanceAdmin.v1` on `analytics-staging-5` for 24 hours. Automation set to revoke at 2026-03-24T10:00:00Z. You should be able to create a t2-small equivalent now.

Renee: I can create the VM now, thank you!! Will post results here. :computer:
